extracted.name: California Farm Mashed Potato Pancakes
extracted.description: Tasty, fluffy thick breakfast pancakes, made from leftover mashed potatoes, or freshly diced potatoes boiled ten minutes, mixed with sauteed greens and grated cheese. Lighter, less oily than hash browns. Served with wedge of lemon and pickle.
ingredient_lines: 3 oz sauteed and chopped spinach or swiss chard, kale or cabbage leaves
Cup buttermilk (fresh, or 1 Tbs buttermilk powder-amazon)
3 oz grated mozarella, cheddar, or other mild cheese (no added salt needed)
instruction_lines: Dice potatoes, cover in boiling water, boil ten minutes, drain, dry in warm pan. Add sauteed chopped greens, mash smooth. Add 1/2 cup all purpose flour, tsp baking powder, cup of buttermilk, mash till smooth thick batter. Stir in freshly ground green pepper, grated cheese, cilantro, parsley.

Heat large skillet, add 2 Tbs olive oil, ladle in batter to make one full pan potato pancake, fry till top is dry and little puffs form. Lift side of pancake, check to see if golden and crusty. Then, cut in 4 slices, flip, fry on other side. Garnish with wedge of lemon, slice of cucumber. Serve, enjoy.
